content: Bacitracin for Injection, USP, is provided in vials containing 50,000 units. The National Drug Code (NDC) for individual vials is 39822-0277-5. For boxes containing ten vials, the NDC is 39822-0277-2. The unreconstituted product should be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature range of 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F). Once reconstituted, the solutions remain stable for up to one week if stored under the same refrigerated conditions of 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F).
